body:
Dedup keywords: `zod-mirror-parity` · `Tests 12 passed` · stale live figure · runtime census · AGENTS.md #9

Surfaced by the `os-dev` seat delivering objectui#9546 (PR objectui#9601) as an out-of-scope finding, and **re-derived on `origin/main` by the `domain:ui` execution seat before filing** — the dev did not file it and was right not to, for the reason in "Why it was not repaired in place" below.

## The reading, taken on `origin/main`

`packages/types/src/__tests__/zod-mirror-parity.test.ts:3006` carries, inside a body docblock:

```
 * `Tests 12 passed (12)` line does not move when this half reddens, correctly, and
```

| probe | reading |
|---|---|
| the quoted figure | **12** |
| actual runtime cases in the file (`it(` / `test(` at line start) | **32** |
| ⭐ lit control — does the instrument read this file at all | `describe(` → **12** hits ⇒ connected |
| ⭐ negative control | `Tests 999999 passed` → **0** ⇒ does not fire spuriously |

Independently corroborated by the dev's own clean baseline run, which printed `Tests 32 passed (32)` both before and after its ablation.

## Why this is class (b), a violated declared contract

`AGENTS.md` #9 is repo-wide and says a docblock must **never write down its answer** — precisely so a figure cannot rot away from the thing it describes. This one has: the sentence reads as a live statement about what the runtime half prints, and it has been wrong by 20 for some time.

⚠️ **The irony is the point, not decoration.** This is the file whose entire purpose is to stop a hand-written restatement from drifting away from what it restates, and it contains exactly that defect in its own prose. ⇒ worth a card rather than a silent edit.

⚠️ **Scope stated honestly:** the file header's own "every LIVE figure in this header is pinned" claim does **NOT** cover this one — the header docblock closes well before line 3006. So no existing pin reddens on it, and nothing will notice it rot further.

## Why it was not repaired in place

The clause the figure sits in is a **RECORD clause** — it records a past measurement — and this file's own governing ruling forbids a later card from rewriting a record clause. Choosing between **deleting the figure** (AGENTS.md #9's default) and **pinning it** (deriving it from the ledger so it cannot rot) is a judgement, not a mechanical edit. ⇒ the bounded in-place exemption fails its second condition, and this needs its own card and its own decision.

## Options (⛔ not a ruling — this card is ungraded and unrouted)

1. **Delete the figure**, leaving the sentence's claim intact without a number. Cheapest, and what AGENTS.md #9 asks for by default.
2. **Pin it** — derive the count from the ledger at runtime so the sentence cannot go stale again. Truest to what the file is for; more machinery in a prose clause.
3. Rewrite the clause so it is no longer a RECORD clause, which the file's own ruling would first have to permit.

## Carrier if this is closed rather than worked

The next PR that edits this file's prose. ⛔ Not PR objectui#9601 — that PR's own surface is the file **header**, and this sits 3000 lines below it; folding it in would have widened a deliberately narrow repair.

⚠️ **Grading and routing are the triage seat's** — this card is filed with no `priority:*` on purpose.
